why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer:
The Settings page now shows the workspace's credit history under the balance, in English and Korean. It type-checks and adds no lint problems, but I did not open it in a browser, so the layout is unverified.

- **What it shows:** a table of when, what for and amount, newest first, scrolling inside its box when long. Charges show as negative numbers; refunds and daily refills show with a `+` in green.
- **Refunds:** a refund row shows the name of the thing that was refunded plus a "Refund" / "환불" badge.
- **Labels:** every charge type and the daily refill has a translated name in both locale files; an action the page doesn't know falls back to "Other" / "기타".
- **Times:** shown in the viewer's local time and locale format. The API sends UTC without a zone, so the page treats those values as UTC.
- **States:** loading, empty ("No credit activity yet.") and a load-failure message are all translated.

The history loads when the page opens or the workspace changes; it does not refresh itself while the page stays open. I added a CHANGELOG bullet.

+"""GET /workspaces/{id}/credits/history lists a workspace's credit changes."""
+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def workspace_id(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def history(client, h, ws_id):
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws_id}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def make_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genre_ids": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_new_workspace_has_an_empty_history(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    assert history(client, h, workspace_id(client, h)) == []
+
+
+def test_charge_is_listed_as_a_negative_amount(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+
+    items = history(client, h, ws)
+
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [("generate_project_cover_image", -15)]
+    assert set(items[0]) == {"amount", "action", "created_at"}
+    datetime.fromisoformat(items[0]["created_at"])
+
+
+def test_refunded_charge_and_its_refund_both_appear_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+
+    items = history(client, h, ws)
+
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [
+        ("refund:generate_project_cover_image", 15),
+        ("generate_project_cover_image", -15),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_daily_refill_is_listed_and_history_is_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    # Reading the workspace grants the daily refill
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert client.post("/api/v1/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "Heavy ink"}).status_code == 200
+
+    items = history(client, h, ws)
+
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [
+        ("style_sample_generation", -10),
+        ("daily_refill", 50),
+        ("generate_project_cover_image", -15),
+    ]
+    stamps = [i["created_at"] for i in items]
+    assert stamps == sorted(stamps, reverse=True)
+
+
+def test_history_only_holds_the_workspace_own_changes(client):
+    h1 = signup(client)
+    h2 = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    pid = make_project(client, h1)
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h1).status_code == 200
+
+    assert len(history(client, h1, workspace_id(client, h1))) == 1
+    assert history(client, h2, workspace_id(client, h2)) == []
+
+
+def test_non_member_gets_404_as_if_the_workspace_did_not_exist(client):
+    h1 = signup(client)
+    h2 = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h1)
+    pid = make_project(client, h1)
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h1).status_code == 200
+
+    outsider = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=h2)
+    missing = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{uuid.uuid4()}/credits/history", headers=h2)
+
+    assert outsider.status_code == 404
+    assert outsider.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_WORKSPACE"
+    assert "amount" not in outsider.text
+    # Same answer as for a workspace that really does not exist
+    assert missing.status_code == 404
+    assert outsider.json() == missing.json()
+
+
+def test_history_needs_a_token(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = workspace_id(client, h)
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history").status_code == 401

+"""Credits are given back when the AI work they paid for fails."""

+
+import pytest

+
+START = 500
+
+
+@pytest.fixture()
+def api(client):
+    """A client that answers 500 instead of raising on unhandled errors."""
+    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+    with TestClient(client.app, raise_server_exceptions=False) as c:
+        yield c
+
+
+def _session():
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+
+    return Session(engine)
+
+
+def _user(s):
+    from app.models.models import User
+
+    return s.exec(select(User).where(User.email == "writer@example.com")).one()
+
+
+def _workspace(s):
+    """The workspace of the signed-up user (the app also seeds a demo one)."""
+    from app.models.models import Workspace
+
+    return s.exec(select(Workspace).where(Workspace.owner_id == _user(s).id)).one()
+
+
+def credits():
+    with _session() as s:
+        return _workspace(s).credits
+
+
+def transactions():
+    from app.models.models import CreditTransaction
+
+    with _session() as s:
+        rows = s.exec(
+            select(CreditTransaction)
+            .where(CreditTransaction.workspace_id == _workspace(s).id)
+            .order_by(CreditTransaction.timestamp)
+        ).all()
+        return [(t.action_type, t.amount) for t in rows]
+
+
+def make_project(api, h):
+    r = api.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genre_ids": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_character(api, h, project_id):
+    r = api.post("/api/v1/characters", headers=h, json={"name": "Mina", "project_id": project_id})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_cut(project_id):
+    from uuid import UUID
+
+    from app.models.models import Episode, StoryCut
+
+    with _session() as s:
+        episode = Episode(title="Ep 1", project_id=UUID(project_id), episode_order=1)
+        s.add(episode)
+        s.commit()
+        cut = StoryCut(episode_id=episode.id, cut_order=1, script="A bus at night", selected_layout="Square", aspect_ratio="1:1")
+        s.add(cut)
+        s.commit()
+        return cut.id
+
+
+def assert_refunded(action, cost):
+    assert credits() == START
+    assert transactions() == [(action, -cost), (f"refund:{action}", cost)]
+
+
+def assert_charged(action, cost):
+    assert credits() == START - cost
+    assert transactions() == [(action, -cost)]
+
+
+# --- Billing service ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+def test_refund_gives_back_what_was_charged_even_if_the_price_changes(api, monkeypatch):
+    from app.services.billing import billing_service
+
+    signup(api)
+    with _session() as s:
+        ws = _workspace(s)
+        user = _user(s)
+        charge_id = billing_service.deduct_credits(s, ws.id, user.id, "generate_project_cover_image")
+        monkeypatch.setitem(billing_service.PRICING, "generate_project_cover_image", {"free": 99})
+        assert billing_service.refund_credits(s, charge_id) is True
+    assert_refunded("generate_project_cover_image", 15)
+
+

+
+    signup(api)

+
+def test_failed_project_cover_is_refunded(api):

+    pid = make_project(api, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    r = api.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert api.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert_refunded("generate_project_cover_image", 15)
+
+
+def test_successful_project_cover_is_charged(api):
+    h = signup(api)
+    pid = make_project(api, h)
+
+    r = api.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+

+    assert api.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "completed"

+

+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+

+
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert api.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert_refunded("generate_project_cover_image", 15)
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_is_refunded(api):
+    h = signup(api)
+    pid = make_project(api, h)
+    cid = make_character(api, h, pid)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+
+    r = api.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)

+

+    assert_charged("generate_character_sheet", 20)

+def test_failed_casting_character_sheet_is_refunded(api):
